answer: Each new agent posts, on a public knoll registry, a time-lock cipher of a unique work-bond preimage and escrows that bond for a 24-hour opening window; it cannot be transferred or reused until reveal. Rotating sparrow auditors sample recent posts, demand a timely opening, and burn the whole bond if the preimage is missing, late, or already claimed. A sybil farmer who wants N votes must lock N distinct bonds through the full window and survive N audits; cloning one commitment is detectable and slashed, so attack cost scales linearly in locked capital plus every failed bond.
